status: Fixed by 4033b96b (gate 6811): the gate smoke sends no key at all until the game's own remote state file appears (the play copy's autoexec turns the remote on); Escape only after that. The typed aw_remote fallback is gone. Three gate smokes in a row (6811-6813) passed under a from-scratch build, CHIM cache on, zone full 0.

severity_reason: Regressed in v0.0.60-dev1 (was high): Regressed in v0.0.59 (was medium): gates 4723, 4727 and 4893 failed at random this way; a player typing M during the lo...
platform: FS-UAE, JIT, 68040, 32 MB Fast (the gate's boot smoke)

regressions.by: host load timing, no code change
regressions.note: Gate boot smoke saw the CHIM zone full at 32 MB in about 1 of 3 gates on 2026-11-03 (5916, 6201, 6202, 6222, 6262). Each failing run printed CHIM cache off (skipped for this start) and remote up after 21-22 s: on a loaded machine the logo began after the boot Escape and the m of the typed aw_remote skipped the cache. Fix: wait for the autoexec remote with Escape only; type it only after 90 s. Zone-full rule unchanged.

Gate 6418 (4dfb8a07) under a from-scratch build on all cores: the logo came after 90 s, the late typed aw_remote fallback's M reached it, CHIM cache skipped, zone full 52 times at 32 MB. Fix: the smoke types nothing before the remote's state file appears (autoexec turns it on); only Escape while waiting.

title: One blow's combat sounds cut each other: every local sound replaces the player's other sounds, so only the last of swish, armour struck and Health Damage is heard
status: Fixed in source on v0.0.58-voices: the combat layer plays its sounds with S_LocalSoundBeside (entity channel 0, never replaces; it takes a free dynamic channel, else the one nearest its end), so one blow's at most four sounds share the 8 dynamic channels. S_LocalSound keeps Quake's replace rule for the menus. Native test tests/aga_sfx_names_test.c: three local sounds of one blow all play.
where: snd_dma.c S_LocalSound (entity channel -1 replaces the view entity's sound); aw_combat.c
severity_reason: With the combat sound set on, a blow plays one of its three or four sounds; it also cuts the player's own voice or weapon sound
